judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus 2x crops of detail regions; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a recognizable grey dolphin with a streamlined body, dorsal fin, and tail fluke.
Show a water surface below the dolphin with a large splash effect at the point where the dolphin has exited the water.
requirements.note: There is no splash at the exit point - only two faint low translucent mounds and a few bubbles at the surface.

requirements.text: Position the dolphin in a dynamic jumping arc, with its entire body in mid-air.
requirements.note: The tail stock and both fluke lobes are drawn well below the waterline, inside the blue water, so the body is not entirely in mid-air.

requirements.text: Draw a circular, multi-colored hula hoop, and position the dolphin so its mid-section is passing through the center of the hoop.
requirements.note: The hoop is not circular: it is two open, unjoined wavy ribbons that never close into a ring, and the dolphin does not pass through any enclosed centre.

requirements.text: Include a human trainer's arm and hand extending into the frame.
The trainer's hand must be holding a small fish by the tail.
requirements.note: The fish's tail fin is at the left and its eye and snout are at the right, inside the trainer's fingers; the fish is held by the head, not the tail.

requirements.text: The dolphin's mouth must be depicted as wide open, just about to bite the body of the fish being held by the trainer.
requirements.note: The dolphin's mouth is almost entirely hidden behind the fish; all that is visible is a thin dark-red sliver, which does not read as a wide-open mouth.
